# Dependency overrides for python 3.11 (replace the requirements of all packages for the listed dependencies)

# zarr-python 3 requires numpy>=2, but nuscenes-devkit 1.2.0 conservatively restricts numpy<2 (validated to work
# with numpy 2 via //tools/data_converter/nuscenes:pytest_converter_3_11) - older nuscenes-devkit versions require
# matplotlib<3.6, which has no python 3.11 wheels
numpy>=2
nuscenes-devkit>=1.2.0
